description:
The GitHub podcast is back for season 2 with new co-hosts Cassidy, Marlene, and GPS! In this premiere episode, the team looks back at standout moments from season 1, including hot takes on Electron performance, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and solving maintainer paper cuts. They also share their personal career journeys across cloud engineering, Python advocacy, and web development. Stick around to hear their weekly open source project recommendations.

#GitHubPodcast #OpenSource #MCP
